note: Boulder RD, Roosevelt NF: on FR 121 off the west side of CO-7 at mile marker 11, ~8,600 ft, 13 mi south of Estes Park near the Longs Peak and Wild Basin trailheads. Not a full-service campground but fills on weekends. --Claude

flags: RIG-LENGTH WORDING: the FS page singles this campground out - 'Sites are best for tent camping due to unpaved roads, steep hills and short pull-ins' (also on recreation.gov). The same agency's Boulder RD status table gives a max spur of 25 ft, which outranks the wording under the rule, so this is information rather than a criteria problem. Reviews: no review in the last 3 years in which the reviewer's own 23 ft+ rig fit. The Dyrt, Kristin P., Jul 23, 2023 (just over 3 years): 'We have a trailer with the van, total ft. is 32' - it 'worked out fine'. Lorraine E., Jul 6, 2025: about 15 sites 'suitable for smaller RVs and trailers', 'Don't go to the end with anything more than a 22''; 'The turnaround is very tight.'
